q.songTitle: Put Your Hand In The Hand
q.line: Every time I look into the Holy Book, I want to tremble (Tremble)
stanza: Every time I look into the Holy Book, I want to tremble (Tremble)
When I read about the part where a carpenter cleared the temple
And those buyers and the sellers, no different, fellas
Than what you and I profess to be
And it causes me shame (Shame) to know that man is not what he should be

partner.line: When I read about the part where a carpenter cleared the temple
